question: Identify the antonym of "Barren"
solution:
The correct answer is: **Fertile**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Barren"** refers to land that is too poor to produce vegetation or fruit or a situation that is unproductive. (बंजर)
 
 
• **Example:** The land was barren, unable to support any crops or vegetation.
 
 
• The antonym of barren is **"Fertile"**, which refers to land capable of producing abundant vegetation or crops, or a situation that is productive. (उपजाऊ)
 
 
• **Example:** The fertile soil
